lane_convention: 1=median-adjacent, increasing outward to 6; 0=inside median line, 7=beyond straight outer line
note: Visible means the reprojected 3-D cuboid intersects the source tile. Eye census is a source review, not a confidence claim for every subpixel horizon identity.

eye.count_interpretation: Primary manual count of marked source silhouettes. Assignment bounds allow the same marks to change lanes; they are not statistical confidence intervals or a full-recall bound. Horizon separability can also change the total.
eye.notes: Top-clipped trucks and small yellow/cyan boxes have uncertain separability/lane. No claim of identity before a box is distinguishable.
eye.residual: Not a full-recall certificate: subpixel/fully occluded source traffic and exact horizon lane membership cannot be established from these images.
